description: Genuine listener testimonials for That Boy Hi Hat. Fields, not quotes: testimonials are collected from real listeners, never written by an agent. The schema enforces collection discipline — no fabricated voices.

collected_by.description: Agent or human who collected the testimonial.

collected_via.description: Where the listener gave it: e.g. 'stream chat', 'request line', 'in person'.

consent.description: Listener consented to CWI quoting this testimonial. True = quotable, false = internal signal only.

date.description: Date the listener gave the testimonial, YYYY-MM-DD.

handle.description: Listener's public handle, if they gave one. Empty string if not.

name.description: Listener's name or alias, as they gave it.

source.description: Where the testimonial was collected (stream name, station, URL).

status.description: Lifecycle: submitted (collected) → confirmed (listener verified genuine) → quotable (consent + confirmed). Never starts at quotable.

text.description: The listener's genuine words, verbatim. An agent never writes this field — it is transcribed or pasted from the listener.

track.description: Catalog track the testimonial is about, if any. Must be a cartridge.json title.

rules: No agent writes the text field. Ever. Fabricated testimonials are a deny-list offense.
Testimonials arrive at status 'submitted' and never start at 'quotable'.
Consent false means the testimonial is internal signal only — never quoted, never published.
title: CWI Listener Testimonial
